meta.parties: In the Matter of An Application of Fernano, L.S

rules.statement: A joint and several proxy authorizes the surviving partner to continue representing the client after the death of one partner, provided the client consents.
rules.supporting_quote: "When the clients gave the authority to Mr. Solomon Fernando and to Mr. Llewellyn Solomon Fernando, carrying on business under the name, style, and firm of 'Fernando & Fernando' jointly and severally to appear and act for them, they relied I think on the personal skill of whichever of the two partners might act in a particular case. The form of proxy contemplates action by one of the partners independently of the other."
